name: Ural sidecar rigs (Gear Up, CT, Patrol)
engine: 749 cc air-cooled boxer twin, carbs then fuel injection, shaft drive, sidecar
intro: Ural's sidecar rigs. Old-school boxer, shaft drive and two-wheel drive on many. Lots of hands-on service.

K: A sidecar rig has three brakes and needs toe-in and lean-out set. Use the Ural manual for alignment.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
